Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred the nationality of the director of "Fighting Through" (Harry L. Fraser) as British solely based on the film being an "American Western" (as stated in the search results). The search results explicitly identified the film as "American," but the Planner assumed the director shared the film's production nationality without verifying the director's actual citizenship. Harry L. Fraser was actually an American director, not British. Consequently, the Planner concluded the directors were from the same country (British), whereas the correct answer is "no" (W.P. Kellino was British, Harry L. Fraser was American). This error matches the pattern of conflating a film's production country with the nationality of its creative personnel without direct verification.
